title: Distribute Candies to People
description: Distribute candies to a row of people, giving 1, 2, 3... candies in turns, looping back to the start when reaching the end.
pseudocode:
1. candies = 7, num_people = 3
2. res = [0, 0, 0]
3. give = 1, i = 0
4. while candies > 0:
5.   res[i % num_people] += min(candies, give)
6.   candies -= give
7.   give += 1
8.   i += 1

steps.note: Give 1 candy to person at index 0
Give 2 candies to person at index 1
Give 3 candies to person at index 2
Remaining 1 candy given to person at index 0
